summary: Specifies how point-to-multipoint BFD is supported in TRILL (Transparent Interconnection of Lots of Links). As with TRILL point-to-point BFD, control packets are carried using RBridge Channel messages. It updates RFC 7175 and RFC 7177 and is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: TRILL is a way of linking bridges together. This document lets one bridge quickly check the health of the paths to many other bridges at once.
